svg.title: Stage 07 Pipeline: Galois Main Summands and the Anticyclotomic Selmer Twisting Theorem
svg.desc: Editorial mathematical pipeline diagram for Stage 07 (RowsFromEigensystems.lean, FitTwistsExist.lean, and Selmer/TwistingTheorem.lean). Band 1 presents two parallel input tracks. Left Input (cobalt): good Hecke eigenforms on W_m of rank r (finite-dimensional via D.e_0) feed exists_isMainSummand_descentPair to produce finitely many rank-r main summands R_a, while main pairs p = (nu, z) of rank 1 (via isRepOfType_one) feed exists_isMainSummand_mainPair to produce finitely many rank-1 main summands R_{1,b}; a highlighted lift trace decomposition panel displays tr(rho_lift^norm) = psi_theta * tr(R) + sum_{e < t} chi_cyc^(-e) (twist-independent main block plus inverse-cyclotomic string, proved by eventually_trace_frob_eq_of_hasLiftHeckePolynomial); these finitely many main summands are packaged by exists_selmerData_isTorsionLevel into a SelmerDatum family over a large coefficient ring O, unramified outside ell p_0 p_1, crystalline above ell, with error beta(T_i) <= c and IsTorsionLevel T (c + 2). Right Input (emerald): Stage 06 (06_one_lift/three_exchanges) feeds all ramified CriticalPairs p = (nu, z) through Selmer/ClassSums.lean into integral twist measures (IsTwistMeasure) interpolating partial Hecke L-values p.ratio xi (+-1), producing StickelbergerSystems in Selmer/LValueSystems.lean. Band 2 (amber, Selmer/TwistingTheorem.lean) runs the Horizontal Anticyclotomic Twisting Engine via exists_mFoldTwist_hasDivisibleSelmerLengthLe (and the two-family wrapper exists_mFoldTwist_selmerLengthLe_inv_ratio_le over A + B), choosing a single m-fold twist tau : D.MFoldTwist on an auxiliary modulus Q with Q, Q-bar, and badPlaces D ell pairwise disjoint, governed by the uniform twist error e'_ell = twistError ell D = (4f + 3) r v_ell(N) + 2^(-ell), together with an explicit caveat that N = D.chosenGroupOrder = prod_{w chosen} |GL_{r*t}(k_w)| uses rank r*t, not r. Band 3 fans out into three simultaneous guarantees holding for every power xi = tau^j (1 <= j <= m): (1) Auxiliary Ramification (IsAuxTwist, amber): psi = xi.invAvatar is anticyclotomic and trivial above ell, with sum_{w in Q} v_ell(psi(gamma_w) - 1) <= e'_ell; (2) Short Divisible Selmer (HasDivisibleSelmerLengthLe, cobalt): every psi R_a and psi R_{1,b} has divisible crystalline Selmer length <= e'_ell, feeding DenominatorBound.lean; (3) Small L-Value Ratios (norm_inv_le_exp_of_ellVal_le, emerald): v_ell(iota_ell(p.ratio xi +-1)) <= e'_ell implies ||iota_ell(p.ratio xi +-1)^(-1)|| <= ell^(e'_ell), summing across primes to <= D.x^999 <= D.x_1 to prove HasSmallRatios in FitTwistsExist.lean.

g.text: Main Summands & Anticyclotomic Selmer Twisting Pipeline
◆ ① GALOIS MAIN SUMMANDS & SELMER DATA
• Rank r: Good Hecke eigenforms on Wm (fin.-dim. via D.e0) → finitely many Ra
• Rank 1: Main pairs p = (ν, z) (via isRepOfType_one) → finitely many R1,b
twist-independent main block R (no ϑ-dependence) + inverse-cyclotomic string
Package into SelmerDatum family over large O
• Unramified outside ℓ p0 p1 · crystalline local conditions above ℓ
• Error β(Ti) ≤ c · large residue field: IsTorsionLevel T (c + 2)
Both signs s = ±1 · partial Hecke L-value ratios
Interpolate partial Hecke L-values p.ratio ξ (±1)
Chooses ONE m-fold twist τ : D.MFoldTwist on auxiliary modulus Q (Q, Q̄, badPlaces D ℓ pairwise disjoint)
UNIFORM TWIST ERROR BOUND (EVERY PRIME ℓ)
e′ℓ = twistError ℓ D = (4f + 3) r vℓ(N) + 2−ℓ
Tolerance 2−ℓ via exists_anticyclotomic_twist; fixed integer N depends only on D
▲ EXPLICIT ORDER DEFINITION (RANK r · t, NOT r)
Product over chosen places w ∣ p0 p1 of GLr·t(kw) — rank r·t, not r
FOR EVERY POWER ξ = τj (1 ≤ j ≤ m) — THREE SIMULTANEOUS GUARANTEES
• Trivial on every decomp. group above ℓ
Q, Q̄, badPlaces D ℓ pairwise disjoint
• Every rank-r ψ Ra and rank-1 ψ R1,b
• Lattice + scalar γ; unram. out. ℓ p0 p1 Q Q̄
• Every ramified p and sign s = ±1:
